name: Auto Cart Quantity Updater
author: Dy Experts

sections.description:
Auto Cart Quantity Updater enhances the WooCommerce experience by automatically updating the cart totals when a user changes product quantities—no need to press “Update Cart” or reload the page.

It works seamlessly on the checkout page, improving user flow and reducing cart abandonment.

Features

  • Instant cart quantity update on change.
  • No page reload needed.
  • Lightweight and easy to integrate.
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes.

How It Works

When a user changes the quantity of a product in the cart or checkout page, the plugin automatically triggers an AJAX request to update the cart totals in real-time.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/auto-cart-quantity-updater directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! The plugin works automatically on the WooCommerce checkout page.
sections.faq:
Does it support custom themes?

Yes, it works with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Does it work with custom checkout pages?

If your custom checkout uses the standard WooCommerce cart HTML structure, it will work. Otherwise, some adjustments may be needed.
